content.prompt:
Water is being pumped into a cylindrical tank at a rate of 15 L every 30 seconds.
The tank has a diameter of 2 m and a height of 1.5 m.
How long will it take to fill the tank? Give the answer in minutes, to the nearest minute.

answer.worked:
For an initially empty tank:
$$\begin{align*}r&=2\div2\text{ m}\\r&=1\text{ m}\\V&=\pi r^2h\\V&=\pi\times1^2\times1.5\text{ m}^3\\V&=1.5\pi\text{ m}^3\\C&=1.5\pi\times1000\text{ L}\\C&=1500\pi\text{ L}\\\text{Rate}&=\frac{15}{30}\times60\text{ L/min}\\\text{Rate}&=30\text{ L/min}\\\text{Time}&=\frac{1500\pi}{30}\text{ min}\\\text{Time}&\approx157\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

classification.difficultyReason: The student halves the diameter and finds the cylinder volume in m³. They convert m³ to litres, turn the pumping rate into L/min or L/s, and divide. There is no diagram, and several unit conversions run through the chain.

content.prompt:
A rectangular sheet of metal measures $40\text{ cm}$ by $25\text{ cm}$.
It is curled up along its $40\text{ cm}$ side to form a cylinder.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the radius of the cylinder.

answer.worked:
The $40\text{ cm}$ side wraps once around the circular end, so it is the circumference.
$$\begin{align*}C&=2\pi r\\40&=2\pi r\\r&=\frac{40}{2\pi}\\r&=\frac{20}{\pi}\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the volume of the cylinder. Answer to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
The height of the cylinder is the other side, $25\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi r^2h\\V&=\pi\left(\frac{20}{\pi}\right)^2\times25\\V&=\frac{10\,000}{\pi}\\V&\approx3183.1\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$

payloads.replacement:
- A **prism** is a 3D solid with two identical, parallel end faces that are polygons, joined by rectangular side faces.
- The **bases** of a prism are its two identical end faces.
- The **height** of a prism is the perpendicular distance between the bases.
- A prism is named by the shape of its base, for example a triangular prism.
- A **cross-section** is the shape formed when a plane slices through a solid.
- A prism has **uniform cross-section**: every cross-section parallel to the base is identical to the base.

A prism is a [[three|17]]-dimensional solid with identical [[opposite end|33]] faces, which are polygons, connected by
[[rectangular|31]] sides.

The base of this prism is a [[triangle|24]] because the triangle is its uniform
[[cross|17]] - [[section|22]]
For other prisms, identify the uniform cross-section as the base and use $V=Ah$.

- A **cylinder** is a 3D solid with two identical circular ends, so every cross-section parallel to the ends is the same circle.
- The volume of a cylinder is $V=Ah$, where $A=\pi r^2$ is the area of the circular base ($r$ is its radius) and $h$ is the perpendicular height between the ends.

- **Volume** is the amount of space a solid takes up.
- **Capacity** is the greatest amount of liquid or gas that a container can hold.
  - A solid block of wood has volume but no capacity.
    It takes up space but cannot hold anything inside it.
  - A plastic bottle has volume and capacity.
    It takes up space and can hold liquid or gas.
- Metric units for capacity are millilitres (mL), litres (L), kilolitres (kL) and megalitres (ML).
